library_preparation_preflight.summary: Standard JavaCPP preset: only Maven dependency is org.bytedeco:javacpp (per resolved POM), matching the openblas/tesseract pattern already in this repo (testImplementation + testRuntimeOnly '<lib>-platform'). No FireWire hardware is needed for meaningful coverage: dc1394_new()/dc1394_camera_enumerate() are documented to degrade gracefully (NULL context / num==0 camera list) when no bus is present, so the no-camera-found path is itself valid native-image reachability coverage. No Docker image applies (no way to emulate a FireWire bus) and no env var/system property is documented as required.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: libdc1394 has no camera hardware in CI. Write tests around the documented no-hardware-found behavior: dc1394_new() may return NULL if no FireWire transport is available, and dc1394_camera_enumerate() on a valid context returns a dc1394camera_list_t with num == 0 rather than erroring — handle both as expected outcomes, not failures. Follow the openblas/tesseract build.gradle precedent: testImplementation "org.bytedeco:libdc1394:$libraryVersion" plus testRuntimeOnly "org.bytedeco:libdc1394-platform:$libraryVersion" (version-variable, not hardcoded — see 2026-10-12 tesseract finding in forge/FINDINGS.md for why hardcoding broke version-agnostic testing).
risks: Low-confidence risk: if the libdc1394-platform native binary dynamically links a system libraw1394/libusb rather than bundling it statically, a container without those system libs could raise UnsatisfiedLinkError at native load time rather than failing gracefully at the dc1394_new() call. No concrete evidence found either way; local Gradle/Native Image verification remains authoritative on this.
